decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Existing Location Plan, Proposed Block Plan, Existing Plan, Proposed Plan, Proposed Roof Plan, Existing Site Elevations, Proposed Okopod Elevations, Proposed Site Elevations, Tree plan, Biodiversity gain plan form, Pre and post development habitat plans, Fire safety statement - Received on 05/08/2024; Design and Access Statement- Received 18/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side (southeast) and rear elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used as a 'classroom for children's services' ancillary to the use of the host building at the site address described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development, a Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the Plan shall include;
(a) information about the steps taken or to be taken to minimise the adverse effect of the development on the biodiversity of the onsite habitat and any other habitat,
(b) the pre-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(c) the post-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat,
(d) any registered offsite biodiversity gain allocated to the development and the biodiversity value of that gain in relation to the development,
(e) any biodiversity credits purchased for the development, and
(f) such other matters as the Secretary of State may by regulations specify.
The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan prior to the first occupation of the development. Any habitats created or enhanced on-site and off-site in accordance with the Biodiversity Gain Plan must be maintained thereafter for a minimum of 30 years.
Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.

Condition : 7 - Habitat management plan  
Notwithstanding the submitted details, no above ground works, excluding demolition, remediation and groundworks, shall take place until a habitat management plan in accordance with the approved Biodiversity Gain Plan must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
The habitat management plan shall include:
a)	Prescription for management actions.
b)	Preparation of the work schedule (including an annual work Plan for over 30-year period and who will carry out the jobs mentioned in the management plans).
c)	Details of the body or organisation responsible for implementation of the plan.
d)	Time frame for reviewing the plan.
e)	Details of the management plans and its communication to the occupiers of the development.
Reason: In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.
description: The proposal is for the construction of an outbuilding, located to the rear of the site. The outbuilding will have an electricity supply and a disabled bathroom. It will be used as a classroom.
